name: University of California: Eligibility in the Local Context (ELC)
description: California residents who rank in the top 9% of their participating California high school graduating class or top 9% statewide are guaranteed admission to a UC campus with available capacity.
applicable_universities: University of California (Guaranteed admission to a UC campus with space)

criteria.label: California Resident attending participating California High School
criteria.fix: Must attend a participating California high school and qualify as a California resident.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 9.0%
criteria.fix: Raise class rank into the top 9.0% of your California high school class.

criteria.label: Minimum 3.00 UC Unweighted GPA in A-G Coursework
criteria.fix: Maintain at least a 3.00 unweighted GPA in certified A-G core subjects.

name: Washington Guaranteed Admissions Program (GAP)
description: Guarantees general undergraduate admission to participating Washington public 4-year universities for high school seniors with at least a 3.0 unweighted GPA who complete required College Academic Distribution Requirements (CADRs).

criteria.label: Washington Resident attending Washington High School
criteria.fix: Must attend a participating public high school in Washington State.

criteria.label: Minimum 3.00 Cumulative Unweighted GPA
criteria.fix: Maintain a minimum 3.00 unweighted cumulative GPA through your junior year.

criteria.label: Complete College Academic Distribution Requirements (CADRs)
criteria.fix: Complete 4 credits of math (including Algebra II) and 3+ credits of lab science.

name: Georgia Match Direct College Admissions
description: Directly guarantees pre-approved college admissions spots to graduating Georgia high school seniors across participating University System of Georgia (USG) and Technical College System of Georgia (TCSG) institutions.

criteria.label: Georgia High School Senior (In-State)
criteria.fix: Must attend an accredited high school in Georgia.

criteria.label: Minimum 2.50+ HOPE-Calculated High School GPA
criteria.fix: Maintain at least a 2.50 unweighted GPA in core academic courses.

criteria.label: Complete Required High School Curriculum (RHSC)
criteria.fix: Complete 4 units of mathematics and 4 units of laboratory science.

name: Florida Talented Twenty Program
description: Guarantees admission to at least one of the 12 State University System of Florida (SUS) institutions for students in the top 20% of their Florida public high school class who complete required college-prep coursework.
applicable_universities: State University System of Florida (12 Public Campuses)

criteria.label: Florida Resident at a Florida Public High School
criteria.fix: Must graduate from a Florida public high school.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 20.0%
criteria.fix: Achieve a class rank in the top 20% of your public high school class.

criteria.label: Minimum 2.50 Cumulative GPA
criteria.fix: Maintain at least a 2.50 GPA with no core subject grades below C.

name: Texas Uniform Admission Policy (Top 10% Rule)
description: Guarantees admission to all Texas public universities (except UT Austin) for Texas high school seniors graduating in the top 10% of their class who complete college-prep curriculum.

criteria.label: Texas Resident attending accredited Texas High School
criteria.fix: Student must graduate from an accredited high school in Texas.

criteria.label: Class rank in the Top 10.0%
criteria.fix: Raise class rank into the top 10% of your graduating class.

criteria.label: College-Prep Math (incl. Algebra II) + 4 Lab Sciences OR SAT/ACT Benchmark
criteria.fix: Complete 4 Math credits (including Algebra II) + 4 Science credits, OR meet SAT college readiness benchmarks.

name: UT Austin Automatic Admission Cap
description: Under Texas statutory cap rules, UT Austin sets an individual cutoff (Top 6% for 2024–2026; Top 5% beginning Fall 2027 entry).

criteria.label: Texas Resident attending accredited Texas High School
criteria.fix: Student must graduate from an accredited high school in Texas.

criteria.label: Class rank in Top 6.0% (Current) / Top 5.0% (Class of 2027+)
criteria.fix: Reach the top 6.0% (or top 5.0% for class of 2027+) of your graduating class.

criteria.label: 4 Math courses (incl. Algebra II) + 4 Science courses
criteria.fix: Complete 4 math courses including Algebra II and 4 lab science courses.

name: National College Readiness Benchmark (Direct Credit-Bearing Placement)
statute: College Board & ACT National Standards / Statewide Higher Ed Placement Policies
description: Across public universities nationwide in all 50 states, meeting official college readiness test benchmarks guarantees direct placement into credit-bearing college English and mathematics coursework without non-credit remedial courses.

criteria.label: SAT Score: 480+ Reading/Writing AND 530+ Math (or ACT Composite 22+)
criteria.fix: Score at least 480 in Reading/Writing and 530 in Math on the SAT, or earn a 22+ ACT composite.

criteria.label: Completed Algebra II and 4 Years of High School Mathematics
criteria.fix: Enroll in and complete Algebra II prior to high school graduation.
